participant_1.name: Walter
participant_1.personality: Strong, nostalgic, and enjoys life to the fullest.
participant_1.background: I'm 100 years old. I'm very strong for my age. I feel like I might live forever. I remember when nobody had a television. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight.

participant_2.name: Jake
participant_2.personality: Friendly, caring, and dedicated to helping others.
participant_2.background: My favorite color is navy blue. I work fulltime in a shipyard. I donate a part of my salary to charity each month. I volunteer my time with a local bunny rescue.
